# Canonical URL: https://zolaha.com

## About Zolaha
Zolaha (named after the agile grasshopper in Purvanchal dialect) is an independent Indian digital product studio and technology company founded by Rishi Ratan Mishra.
True to its name, Zolaha builds agile, featherlight, and privacy-first digital products and web software designed to deliver instant utility with zero bloat and zero server retention.

## Core Products & Verticals
1. Zolaha FormCraft: Instant exam and career compliance engine for competitive exam aspirants.
2. Zolaha Vault: 100% private in-browser document workstation (PDF tools, encryption, sensitive data redaction).
3. Zolaha MediaCraft: High-performance visual asset and image optimization suite.
4. Zolaha MicroFlow: Lightweight commerce and utility tools for small businesses and digital creators.

## Brand Principles
- Agile & Featherlight: Sub-second load times, lightweight code, zero battery or CPU drain.
- Zero-Server-Knowledge: 100% client-side execution via HTML5 Canvas and WebAssembly.
- Grounded Heritage: Founded in Purvanchal, Uttar Pradesh, engineered for global standards.
